entries.text: the Little Dart Mk 13 is 25% done!

Worked on the Little Dart Mk 13 (version 3, 25% built): Adding a layer of repurposed heat shielding around the cockpit seam to prep for the final seal. I am using a steady hand to make sure the bond is strong enough for deep space. (used Nim, a coil of copper wire)
meticulously welding the cockpit seam for total airtightness
